nodes.name: Lawful forensic investigation in a smart home for IoT-enabled crime
nodes.role: Bounds the agreed unauthorized-entry and sensor-tampering vertical slice

nodes.name: Resident or data subject
nodes.role: Produces normal interactions and protected context

nodes.name: Authorized investigator
nodes.role: Requests scoped acquisition and reviews reconstruction

nodes.name: Authorizing authority
nodes.role: Issues the synthetic authorization object
nodes.notes: Does not model real judicial procedure

nodes.name: CPE operator support role
nodes.role: Provides controlled acquisition mechanism

nodes.name: Unauthorized actor
nodes.role: Causes entry and disables the door sensor
nodes.notes: Identity intent and guilt are not inferred

nodes.name: System auditor
nodes.role: Verifies policy evidence and custody records

nodes.name: Open-source CPE router
nodes.role: Routes traffic and exposes controlled acquisition interface

nodes.name: Home Assistant host
nodes.role: Maintains registry states event history and automation rules
nodes.notes: Separate logical entity even if co-hosted

nodes.name: Door and window contact sensor
nodes.role: Observes entrance state and is the primary tampered device

nodes.name: Presence sensor
nodes.role: Probabilistically corroborates movement

nodes.name: Smart plug
nodes.role: Representative controllable device not attacked in the primary run

nodes.name: Smart light
nodes.role: Executes entry automation and creates a corroborating state trace
nodes.notes: On or off mandatory; brightness optional

nodes.name: Authorization object
nodes.role: Governs evidence acquisition eligibility

nodes.name: CPE network record
nodes.role: Network-level source artefact

nodes.name: Home Assistant event
nodes.role: Automation-level source artefact

nodes.name: Device state event
nodes.role: Physical-device observation

nodes.name: Evidence item
nodes.role: Preserved source artefact with provenance

nodes.name: Case trigger
nodes.role: Starts investigation workflow but not authority

nodes.name: Policy decision
nodes.role: Records allow deny or minimize outcome
nodes.notes: Denied decisions contain no protected payload

nodes.name: Custody action
nodes.role: Records evidence handling history

nodes.name: Reconstruction claim
nodes.role: Expresses a qualified inference supported by evidence
nodes.notes: Cannot state actor identity intent guilt or admissibility

nodes.name: CPE digital counterpart
nodes.role: Mirrors CPE state capabilities and observations

nodes.name: Home Assistant digital counterpart
nodes.role: Mirrors gateway application state and connectivity

nodes.name: Door sensor digital counterpart
nodes.role: Mirrors door sensor state including tamper or offline

nodes.name: Presence sensor digital counterpart
nodes.role: Mirrors reported presence state and quality

nodes.name: Smart-plug digital counterpart
nodes.role: Mirrors smart-plug state and optional telemetry

nodes.name: Smart-light digital counterpart
nodes.role: Mirrors smart-light state and command status

nodes.name: Smart-home premises
nodes.role: Bounds physical incident events
nodes.notes: Logical location only; no real address

nodes.name: Home IoT LAN
nodes.role: Carries internal IoT communications

nodes.name: WAN and Internet boundary
nodes.role: Bounds external communications
nodes.notes: Optional cloud communication disabled by default

nodes.name: LEA secured environment
nodes.role: Hosts controlled forensic services

nodes.name: Vendor cloud adapter
nodes.role: Optionally represents off-premises events and commands

nodes.name: Lawful-interception module
nodes.role: Validates decisions and performs scoped acquisition

nodes.name: Evidence repository
nodes.role: Stores content-addressed evidence and manifests

nodes.name: Custody ledger adapter
nodes.role: Maintains append-only custody history

nodes.name: Reconstruction service
nodes.role: Normalizes correlates and reconstructs a qualified timeline

nodes.name: Digital Twin service
nodes.role: Maintains digital replicas relations and simulation state
